newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror to sell CRC Press unit.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror to sell CRC Press unit.

text.p: Times Mirror Co. said Thursday it will sell the assets of its CRC Press Inc. unit to Information Ventures LLC, a company owned by Warburg, Pincus Ventures LP and investor Mason Slaine.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Times Mirror, owner of the Los Angeles Times, Baltimore Sun, Newsday and other newspapers, has previously said it would sell Boca Raton, Fla.-based CRC as part of a divestiture of its higher education business unit.
Times Mirror stock gained $1 to $52.625 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
